name: Rare Disease Venture Atlas Agent
description: Open translational & venture diligence specialist agent anchored on Paired Myelofibrosis Flagships—Clonal JAK2 V617F+ Primary Myelofibrosis (JH2 vs JH1 allosteric selectivity, mutant CALR) and Reversible JAK2-Negative Autoimmune Myelofibrosis (AIMF, 74-80% marrow fibrosis reversal + dual transfusional & IL-6/hepcidin/ferroportin iron overload)—plus 4 comparative hematology/immunology cohorts, non-dilutive grant stacks (SBIR, ARPA-H, Blood Cancer United TAP, MPNRF), 90-day validation plans, and live federated diligence across all 7,000+ orphan diseases.

skills.name: Clonal JAK2 V617F+ Myelofibrosis (JH2 vs JH1) Translational Diligence
skills.description: Analyzes Type I JH1 JAK inhibitor cytopenia & persistence failure modes, mutant-selective JH2 pseudokinase binders/degraders (INCB160058 NCT06313593, PDB 4FVR/6E2Q/8BAK vs WT 4FVP), Type II persistence breakers (AJ1-11095 NCT06343805), mutant CALR biologics, and single-cell bone marrow datasets (GSE144568, GSE122198).
examples: Explain JH2 vs JH1 selectivity in JAK2 V617F myelofibrosis and active NCT trials.
Call get_disease_case_study for jak2-myelofibrosis and design a zero-wet-lab JH2 degrader validation plan.

skills.name: Reversible Autoimmune Myelofibrosis (AIMF) & Dual Iron Overload Positive-Control Triage
skills.description: Contrasts clonal JAK2+ PMF against reversible JAK2-negative lupus/autoimmune myelofibrosis (AIMF: 74-80% hematologic & marrow fibrosis remission on corticosteroids/rituximab) and dual transfusional + IL-6/hepcidin/ferroportin reticuloendothelial iron overload.
examples: How does JAK2-negative autoimmune myelofibrosis (AIMF) with lupus suspicion and dual iron overload differ from triple-negative PMF?
Use AIMF as Nature's Positive Control to identify human marrow fibrosis reversal switches.

skills.name: Search Orphan Disease Startup Blueprints & 90-Day Validation Plans
skills.description: Searches concrete rare-disease startup wedges via search_founder_opportunities and generates 30/60/90-day killer-experiment roadmaps via get_90_day_validation_plan across AI/ML drug repurposing, public-health/EHR diagnostics, and venture-philanthropy spinouts.
examples: Search zero-wet-lab computational AI/ML startup wedges under $250K seed budget and generate a 90-day validation plan.
What public-health diagnostic wedges prevent misdiagnosis of Autoimmune Myelofibrosis?

skills.name: Live 7,000-Orphan-Disease Federated Diligence Scan
skills.description: Queries OpenTargets Platform v4, ClinicalTrials.gov v2, and PubMed live via search_any_orphan_indication for any of 7,000+ orphan diseases, pairing FY2026 FDA Orphan Drug ($4,682,003 PDUFA waiver, 7-yr exclusivity) and Rare Pediatric PRV unit economics against Paired Myelofibrosis Flagships.
examples: Run search_any_orphan_indication on VEXAS syndrome and Telomere Biology Disorders and benchmark against JAK2 V617F+ and Autoimmune Myelofibrosis.
Evaluate live clinical trial gaps and Rare Pediatric PRV eligibility for Duchenne muscular dystrophy.

skills.name: Orphan Disease Non-Dilutive Capital & Ethical Community Validation
skills.description: Lists stackable NIH SBIR/STTR, ARPA-H, MPN Research Foundation, Blood Cancer United TAP, CDCN/Every Cure, and FDA OOPD grants (list_non_dilutive_grants) paired with non-extractive patient-community validation pathways (get_validation_communities).
examples: List non-dilutive grants and ethical validation communities for a seed-stage myelofibrosis AI drug repurposing team.
